English: This study aimed to establish the dietary practices, assess nutrition status based on body mass index and the relationship between dietary diversity and nutrition status of female undergraduate students at Kenyatta University, Kenya.

English: The results showed that 64.0% of the participants had consumed ≥ 5 food groups while 36% had consumed <5 food groups over a period of 24 hours.
Luganda: Ebyavaamu byalaga nti abeetabi ebitundu 64.0% baalya ebibinja by’emmere ≥ 5 ate ebitundu 36% baali balidde ebibinja by’emmere <5 mu kiseera ekisukka ku ssaawa 24.
Yoruba: Èsì fi hàn pé ìdá 64.0 àwọn akópa ní wọ́n máa ń jẹ́ oríṣìí ìpín oúnjẹ tó dín tàbí jẹ́ 5, nígbà tí ìdá 36 ń jẹ́ oríṣìí ìpín tí kò tó 5 láàárín wákàtí 24.
Zulu: Imiphumela iveze ukuthi amaphesenti angama-64.0% alabo ababambe iqhaza ocwaningweni, badla izinhlobo eziwu-5 kuya phezulu zokudla ngosuku lulunye, bese kuthi abangamaphesenti angama-36% bona badla izinhlozo eziwu-5 zokudla esikhathini esingamahora angama-24.
Hausa: Sakamakon ya nuna cewa kashi 64.0% na ɗaliban sun cinye rukunonin abinci ≥ 5 a yayin da kashi 36% sun cinye rukunonin abinci <5 a cikin awanni 24.
Northern Sotho: Dipoelo di laeditše gore 64.0% ya bakgathatema e šomišitše ≥ 5 ya dihlopha tša dijo mola 36% yona e šomišitše <5 ya dihlopha tša dijo mo go lebakanako la diiri tše 24.
Amharic: ውጤቶቹ እንደሚያሳዩት ከተሳታፊዎች ውስጥ 64.0% የሚሆኑት ≥ 5 የምግብ ቡድኖችን ሲበሉ 36% ደግሞ በ24 ሰዓታት ውስጥ <5 የምግብ ቡድኖችን እንደበሉ አሳይተዋል።

English: In terms of nutrition status, 68.4% of the participants had normal Body Mass Index while 23.9% were overweight, 5.55% were underweight and 2.3% were obese.
Luganda: Bw’otunuulira Embeera y’ebiriisa, ebitundu 68.4% eby’abeetabi baalina Obugabize bw’obuzito n’obuwanvu bw’omubiri obwa bulijjo, ate ebitundu 23.9% baali basusse ku buzito bwe balina okuba nabwo, ebitundu 5.55% baali tebaweza buzito bwe balina kuba nabwo n’ebitundu 2.3% baalina omugejjo.
Yoruba: Ní ti ipò ìfohúnjẹfáran, ìdá méjìdínláàádọ́rin lé mérin (68.4%) nínú àwọn akópa ní wọ́n ní ìwọ̀n ara tí ó gúnrégé, nígbàtí ìdá mẹ́tàlélógún àti mẹ́sàn-án (23.9%) tóbijù bí ó ti yẹ, tí ìdá márùn-ún àti márùnléláàádọ́ta (5.55%) kéré ju bí ó ti yẹ, nígbàtí ìdá méjì lémẹ́ta (2.3%) sì jẹ́ àbéńtè.
Zulu: Ngokwesimo sokudla okunomsoco, u-68.4% wabahlanganyeli babene-Body Mass Index evamile kuyilapho u-23.9% ukhuluphele, u-5.55% wawungaphansi kwesisindo kanti u-2.3% wawukhuluphele.
Hausa: Dangane da matsayin abinci mai gina jiki, kashi 68.4% na ɗaliban suna da Kimar Nauyi da Tsawo na jiki daidai, a yayin da kashi 23.9% suke da ƙiba, kashi 5.55% ba su da ƙiba kuma 2.3% na da teɓa.
Northern Sotho: Mabapi le maemo a phepo, 68.4% ya bakgathatema e bile le Dipalopalo tša Boima bja Mmele tše di tlwaelegilego mola 23.9% e be e nonne kudu, 5.55% ba be ba le ba basesane gomme 2.3% e be e tletšwe ke mmele.
Amharic: በሥነ-ምግብ ሁኔታ መሰረት 68.4% ከተሳታፊዎቹ መደበኛ የሰውነት ክብደት መጠን ጠቋሚ ሲኖራቸው 23.9% ከመጠን ያለፈ ክብደት፣ 5.55% ከመጠን ያለፈ ዝቅተኛ ክብደት እና 2.3% ከመጠን ያለፈ ውፍረት ያላቸው ናቸው።

English: Researchers say poor food choices and a lack of food variety is behind ill health and high levels of obesity seen in female undergraduate students at Kenya’s Kenyatta University.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza bagamba nti ennonda y’emmere embi n’obutaba na mmere ya njawulo kye kiviirako obulwadde n’omugejjo ogulabikira mu bayizi ab’obuwala abaddiguli esooka ku Ssettendekero ya Kenyatta mu Kenya.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùwádìí sọ pé àsàyà oúnjẹ́ tí kò dára àti àì sí àwọn onírúurú oúnjẹ ní o ṣe okùnfà àìlerà àti àrùn àbéńtè tí ó wọ́pọ̀, tí wọ́n ri láàárín àwọn àwọn ọmọbìnrin akẹ́kọ̀ọ́ fóyè-àkọ́kọ́ tí wọ́n wà ní Yunifásitì Kenyatta ní Kenya.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathi ukukhetha uhlobo lokudla okungawulungele umzimba kanye nokwentuleka kwezinhlobo zokudla ezikhona yikho okuyimbangela yokugula kanye nokukhuluphla ngokweqile kwalaba bafundi.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ce rashin zaɓin abinci da rashin abinci iri-iri ne ke haddasa rashin lafiya da yawan ƙiba da ake gani a jikin ɗalibai mata masu karatun digirin farko a Jami’ar Kenyatta ta ƙasar Kenya.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba bolela gore dikgetho tše di sa kgahlišego ka ga dijo le tlhokego ya mehutahuta ya dijo ke seo se bakago maphelo ao a fokolago le maemo a godimo a go nona fao go bonwago go baithuti ba basadi ba kgrata ya mathomo ka Yunibesithing ya Kenyatta ka Kenya.
Amharic: የኬንያ ኬንያታ ዩኒቨርሲቲ ውስጥ የመጀመሪያ ዲግሪ በሚማሩ ሴት ተማሪዎች ላይ ከሚታየው የጤና መቃወስ እና ከፍተኛ ውፍረት በስተጀርባ ደካማ የምግብ ምርጫ እና የምግብ አይነት እጥረት እንዳለ ተመራማሪዎች ተናግረዋል።

English: Lifestyle changes and habits in Kenya have led to an increase in obesity generally, and for students in particular, such dietary choices may impact their health for the rest of their lives.
Luganda: Okutwaliza awamu, enkyukakyuka mu mbeera y’obulamu n’empisa z’abantu mu Kenya bireetedde omugejjo okweyongera, ate naddala mu bayizi, era ennonda y’emmere ey’enyengeri eyo eyinza okukosa obulamu bwabwe ebbanga lyonna lye banaamala ku nsi.
Yoruba: Àtúnṣe sí ìgbé-ayé àti ìsòṣedibárakú ní ó fàá tí àrùn àbéńtè fi wọ́pọ̀ ní Kenya lápapọ̀, àti fún àwọn akẹ́kọ̀ọ́ ní pàtó, irúfẹ́ oúnjẹ́-yíyàn yìí le è kó ipa lórí ayé wọn títí láíláí.
Zulu: Ukushintsha kwendlela yokuphila kanye nemikhuba eKenya kuholele ekwenyukeni kokukhuluphala ngokujwayelekile, futhi ikakhulukazi kubafundi, ukukhetha okunjalo kokudla kungaba nomthelela empilweni yabo impilo yabo yonke.
Hausa: Sauye-sauyen salon rayuwa da halaye a ƙasar Kenya sun haifar da haɓakar ƙiba gabaɗaya, kuma musamman ma ga ɗalibai, irin waɗannan zaɓin abincin na iya yin tasiri ga lafiyarsu har tsawon rayuwarsu.
Northern Sotho: Diphetogo ka ga mekgwa ya bophelo le ditlwaedi ka Kenya go bakile seemo sa go nona ka kakaretšo, kudukudu ga baithuti, dikgetho tša mohuta woo tša dijo di ka ama maphelo a bona bophelong bja bona ka moka.
Amharic: በኬንያ ውስጥ የአኗኗር ዘይቤ ለውጦች እና ልማዶች በአጠቃላይ ከመጠን በላይ የውፍረት በሽታ እንዲጨምር ምክንያት ሆኗል፤ እና በተለይ ለተማሪዎች እንዲህ ያለው የአመጋገብ ምርጫ በቀሪው ሕይወታቸው ጤና ላይ ተጽዕኖ ሊያሳድር ይችላል።

English: A study among undergraduate students in Nairobi showed that 22.9% of the students were overweight and obese, while 5.5% were underweight.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza okwakolebwa mu bayizi abaddiguli esooka mu Nairobi kwalaga nti abayizi ebitundu 22.9% baalina obuzito obususse ku bwe balina okuba nabwo era nga balina omugejjo, ate ng’ebitundu 5.5% baali tebaweza buzito bwe balina kuba nabwo.
Yoruba: Ìṣẹ ìwadìí láàárín àwọn akẹ́kọ̀ọ́ fóyè-àkọ́kọ́ ní Nairobi fihàn pé ìdá méjìlélógún lé mẹ́sàn-án (22.9%) àwọn akẹ́kọ̀ọ́ ní wọ́n sanra jù bí ó ti yẹ tí wọ́n sì jẹ́ àbéńtè, nígbàtí ìdá márùn lé márùn-ún (5.5%) kéré ju bí ó ti yẹ.
Zulu: Ucwaningo kubafundi abangakethweswa iziqu edolobheni lase-Nairobi luveze ukuthi bangamaphesenti angama-22.9% abafundi abakhuluphele ngokweqile ebese kuthi abangamaphesenti ayisi-5.5% bona bonde ngokweqile.
Hausa: Wani bincike da aka gudanar a tsakanin ɗaliban da suka kammala karatun digirin farko a birnin Nairobi ya nuna cewa kashi 22.9% na ɗaliban suna da ƙiba da teɓa, yayin da kashi 5.5% ba su da ƙiba.
Northern Sotho: Dinyakišišo tšeo di dirilwego gareng ga baithuti ba kgrata ya mathomo ka Nairobi di laeditše gore 22.9% ya baithuti ba nonne ebile ba tletšwe ke mebele kudu, mola 5.5% ya bona yona e na le mebele ye mesesane.
Amharic: በናይሮቢ ውስጥ በመጀመሪያ ዲግሪ ተማሪዎች መካከል የተደረገ ጥናት እንደሚያሳየው ከተማሪዎቹ 22.9% ከመጠን ያለፈ ክብደት እና ውፍረት ያለባቸው ሲሆን 5.5% የሚሆኑት ደግሞ ከመጠን ያለፈ ዝቅተኛ ክብደት ያላቸው ናቸው።

English: This study looked specifically at the diets and health of female students at Kenyatta University.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza kuno kwekaliriza emmere n’obulamu bw’abayizi ab’obuwala ku Ssettendekero ya Kenyatta.
Yoruba: Iṣẹ́ ìwadìí ṣe àyẹ̀wò oúnjẹ́ jíjẹ àti ìlera àwọn akẹ́kọ̀ọ́bìnrin Yunifásitì Kenyatta ní pàtó.
Zulu: Lolu cwaningo lubheke ngokukhethekile indlela yokudla kanye nesimo sezempilo sabafundi beNyuvesi iKenyatta.
Hausa: Wannan binciken ya yi nazari ne musamman a kan abinci da kuma lafiyar ɗalibai mata a Jami’ar Kenyatta.
Northern Sotho: Dinyakišišo tše di lekodišišitše kudu go dijo le maphelo a baithuti ba basadi ka Yunibesithing ya Kenyatta.
Amharic: ይህ ጥናት በተለይ በኬንያታ ዩኒቨርሲቲ የሴት ተማሪዎችን አመጋገብ እና ጤና አስሷል።

English: Researchers wanted to identify diets that are most likely to cause obesity and ill health.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baayagala okumanya emmere eyinza okusinga okuleeta omugejjo n’okulwala.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùwádìí fẹ́ láti da àwọn àṣàyàn oúnjẹ́ tí ó ń ṣokùnfa àrùn àbéńtè àti àìlerà mọ̀.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bebefuna ukuveza obala izindlela zokudla okuyizo ezidala kakjhulu ukukhuluphala ngokweqile kanye nesimo sempilo esicikizayo kubafundi.
Hausa: Masu bincike sun so gano abincin da zai iya haifar da ƙiba da kuma rashin lafiya.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba be ba nyaka go tseba dijo tšeo go nago le kgonagalo ye kgolo ya gore di ka baka go nona kudu le maphelo ao a fokolago.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎች ለውፍረት በሽታ እና ለጤንነት መጓደል ሊዳርጉ የሚችሉ ምግቦችን ለይተው ማወቅ ፈልገው ነበር።

English: The researchers did a cross-sectional study of 422 female undergraduate students randomly selected from Kenyatta University.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baakola okunoonyereza o’w'ekiseera ekimpi ku bayizi baddiguli esooka 422 nga balondeddwa mu ngeri ya kulabiraawo okuva mu Ssettendero kya Kenyatta.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùwádìí ṣe ìwádìí àṣẹkiri láàárín àwọn ọmọbìnrin akẹ́kọ̀ọ́ gboyè-àkọ́kọ́ 422 tí wọ́n ṣàyàn kiri ní Yunifásitì Kenyatta.
Zulu: Abacwaningi benze ucwaningo kubafundi abangakathweswa iziqu beNyuvesi iKenyetta ngaphandle kokubakhetha ngokuhleliwe abangama-442 besifazane.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun yi wani nazari mai zurfi ne a kan wasu ɗalibai mata masu karatun digirin farko guda 422 waɗanda aka zaɓa kara zube daga Jami’ar Kenyatta.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba dirile dinyakišišo tša go putlaganya mafapha go baithuti ba basadi ba 422 ba kgrata ya mathomo bao ba kgethilwego ka sewelo ka Yunibesithing ya Kenyatta.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ በኬንያታ ዩኒቨርሲቲ በዘፈቀደ የተመረጡ 422 ሴት የመጀመሪያ ዲግሪ ተማሪዎች ላይ ሰፊ የክፍል በክፍል ጥናት አድርገዋል።

English: They interviewed the students about the diversity in their diets, as well as how often they eat.
Luganda: Baabuuza abayizi ku bika by’emmere mu mmere gye balya n’emirundi gye balya.
Yoruba: Wọ́n fi ọ̀rọ̀ wá àwọ́n akẹ́kọ̀ọ́ náà lẹ́nu wò nípa ìyàtọ̀ tí ó wà nínú àṣàyàn oúnjẹ́ wọn, àti bí wọ́n ṣe ń jẹun sí.
Zulu: Babe sebexoxa nabafundi mayelana nokwehlukahlukana kwezindlela zokudla baphinde baxoxa nangokuthi badla kangaki.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun tattauna da ɗaliban game da bambancin abincin da suke ci, da kuma yawan cin abincin.
Northern Sotho: Ba ile ba botšiša baithuti ba dipotšišo ka ga go farogana ga dijo tšeo ba di jago, gammogo le gore ba ja ga kae.
Amharic: በአመጋገባቸው ውስጥ ስላለው ልዩነት እና በምን ያህል ጊዜ እንደሚመገቡ ለተማሪዎቹን ቃለ መጠይቅ አድርገዋል።

English: The study found that 64.0% of the female students consumed 5 food groups, while 36% had consumed fewer than 5 food groups over a period of 24 hours.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza kwakizuula nti abayizi ab’obuwala ebitundu 64.0% baalya ebika by’emmere 5 ate ebitundu 36% bo nga tebaweza bika 5 mu kiseera eky’essaawa 24.
Yoruba: Ìwádìí náà fi hàn pé ìdá 64.0 àwọn akẹ́kọ̀ọ́bìnrin ní wọ́n máa ń jẹ́ oríṣìí ìpín oúnjẹ 5, nígbà tí ìdá 36 ń jẹ́ oríṣìí ìpín tí kò tó 5 láàárín wákàtí 24.
Zulu: Ucwaningo luthole ukuthi amaphesenti angama 64% abafundi besifazane badla izinhlobo zokudla ezehlukaniswe kahlanu ngenkathi abanye abangamaphesenti angama-36% bona bedla izinhlobo zokudla ezingafikile kwezinhlanu ngosuku.
Hausa: Binciken ya gano cewa kashi 64.0% na ɗaliban mata sun cinye rukunonin abinci 5, a yayin da kashi 36% suka cinye ƙasa da rukunonin abinci 5 a cikin awanni 24.
Northern Sotho: Dinyakišišo di utollotše gore 64.0% ya baithuti ba basadi ba ja dihlopha tše 5 tša dijo, mola e le gore ba 36% ba be ba eja ka fase ga dihlopha tše 5 tša dijo mo go lebakanako la diiri tše 24.
Amharic: ጥናቱ እንደሚያሳየው 64.0% ሴት ተማሪዎች 5 የምግብ ቡድኖችን ሲመገቡ 36% ደግሞ በ24 ሰዓት ውስጥ ከ5 ያነሰ የምግብ ቡድኖችን ይጠቀማሉ።

English: The food groups most consumed by the participants were cereals at 92%, and vegetables at 78.4%.
Luganda: Ebika by’emmere abeetabi bye baasinga okulya mwalimu emmere ey’empeke 92%, n’enva endiirwa ebitundu 78.4%.
Yoruba: Ìpín irúfẹ́ oúnjẹ́ tí àwọn akohpa ṣábà máa ń jẹ jùlọ ni sírílì, èyí tí ìdá mẹjìléláàádọ́rùn-ún (92%) máa ń jẹ àti ewébẹ̀ tí ìdá méjìdínlọ́gọ́rin àti mẹ́rin (78.4%) máa ń jẹ.
Zulu: Izinhlobo zokudla ezidliwa kakhulu yilabo ababeyingxenye yokuqoqwa kolwazi kulolu cwaningo kubalwa amaphesenti angama-92% okudla okuthakwe ngezinhlamvu zikakolweni (cereals) nokudliwa kakhulu ekuseni kanye namaphesenti angama-78.4% okudla kohlobo lwemifino.
Hausa: Rukunonin abincin da ɗaliban suka fi cinyewa su ne hatsi a kashi 92% da kayan lambu kuma a kashi 78.4%.
Northern Sotho: Dihlopha tša dijo tšeo di bego di jewa kudu ke bakgathatema ebile diserele ka 92%, le merogo ka 78.4%.
Amharic: በተሳታፊዎች በብዛት የተበሉት የምግብ ቡድኖች 92% የእህል ምርቶች እና 78.4% አትክልቶች ናቸው።

English: Nuts and seeds were the least consumed at 18.4%.
Luganda: Ebinyeebwa n’empeke endala bye byasinga okuliibwa mu butono ku bitundu 18.4%.
Yoruba: Kóró àti èso ni ó kéré jùlọ nínú ohun tí wọ́n máa ń jẹ, èyí tí ó jẹ́ ìdá mejìdílógún àti mẹ́rin (18.4%).
Zulu: Uhlobo lokudla okungamakinati kanye nohlobo oluyimbewu kona ucwaningo luveze ukuthi kudliwa kancane kakhulu ngamaphesenti nje ayi-18.4%.
Hausa: Dangogin gyaɗa sun kasance mafi ƙarancin abin da suka ci a kashi18.4%.
Northern Sotho: Dimake le dipeu ebile tšeo di bego di sa jewe kudu ka 18.4%.
Amharic: በትንሹ ለውዝ እና ዘሮች 18.4% ተበልተዋል።

English: The study found that 68.4% of the participants had normal Body Mass Index, while 23.9% were overweight, 5.55% were underweight and 2.3% were obese.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza kwazuula nti abeetabi ebitundu 68.4% baalina Obugabize bw’obuzito n’obuwanvu bw’omubiri obwa bulijjo ate ebitundu 23.9% baali basusse ku buzito bwe balina okuba nabwo, ebitundu 5.55% baali tebaweza buzito bwe balina kuba nabwo n’ebitundu 2.3% baalina omugejjo.
Yoruba: Ìwádìí fi hàn pé ìdá méjìdínláàádọ́rin lé mérin (68.4%) nínú àwọn akópa ní wọ́n ní ìwọ̀n ara tí ó gúnrégé, nígbàtí ìdá mẹ́tàlélógún àti mẹ́sàn-án (23.9%) tóbijù bí ó ti yẹ, tí ìdá márùn-ún àti márùnléláàádọ́ta (5.55%) kéré ju bí ó ti yẹ, nígbàtí ìdá méjì lémẹ́ta (2.3%) sì jẹ́ àbéńtè.
Zulu: Ucwaningo luthole ukuthi kulabo abebeyingxenye yakwenziwa kwalolu cwaningo bangamaphesenti angama-68.4% abanesisindo somzimba esikahle ebesekuthi abangamaphesenti angama-23.9% bona banesisindo somzimba eseqile kwesifanele, abangapmaphesenti ama-5.55% bona bondekakhulu, bese bebangamaphesenti ama-2.3% bakhuluphele ngokweqile.
Hausa: Binciken ya gano cewa kashi 68.4% na ɗaliban suna da Kimar Nauyi da Tsawo daidai, a yayin da kashi 23.9% suke da ƙiba, kuma kashi 5.55% ba su da ƙiba kuma kashi 2.3% na da teɓa.
Northern Sotho: Dinyakišišo di utollotše gore 68.4% ya bakgathatema ba bile le Dipalopalo tša Boima bja Mmele tše di tlwaelegilego, mola 23.9% e be e nonne kudu, 5.55% e be e na le mebele ye mesesane gomme 2.3% yona e be e tletšwe ke mebele.
Amharic: ጥናቱ እንደሚያሳየው ከተሳታፊዎቹ 68.4% መደበኛ የሰውነት ክብደት መጠን ጠቋሚ፣ 23.9% ከመጠን ያለፈ ክብደት፣ 5.55% ከመጠን ያለፈ ዝቅተኛ ክብደት እና 2.3% ከመጠን ያለፈ ውፍረት ያላቸው ናቸው።

English: The researchers determined that the majority (68.4%) of the students were in good health.
Luganda: Abaanoonyereza baakirengera nti abayizi abasinga obungi (68.4%) baali balamu bulungi.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùwádìí fi múlẹ̀ pé ọ̀pọ̀ àwọn akẹ́kọ̀ọ́ (ìdá méjìdínláàádọ́rin lé mérin - 68.4%) ní wọ́n wà ní ìlera pihpé.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathole ukuthi iningi labafundi ngamaphesenti angama-68.4% lisesimeni esikahle sempilo.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ƙaddara cewa yawanci (kashi 68.4%) na ɗaliban suna cikin ƙoshin lafiya.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba utollotše gore bontši bja baithuti ka (68.4%) ba be ba phetše gabotse.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ አብዛኛቹ (68.4%) ተማሪዎች በጥሩ ጤንነት ላይ መሆናቸውን ደርሰውበታል።

English: The researchers don’t explain why they specifically looked at women students only.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza tebannyonnyola nsonga yabaleetera kutunuulira bayizi babuwala bokka.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùwádìí kò ṣàlàyé ìdí tí ó fi jẹ́ wí pé à obìnrin nìkan ni wọ́n ṣe àyẹ̀wò rẹ̀.
Zulu: Abacwaningi laba kabachazi ukuthi kungani banquma ukuthi bebheke kuphela abafundi besifazane kuphela.
Hausa: Masu binciken ba su bayyana dalilin da ya sa suka kalli ɗalibai mata kawai ba.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ga ba hlaloše gore ke ka lebaka la eng ba lebeletše kudu baithuti ba basadi fela.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ ለምን ሴት ተማሪዎችን ብቻ እንደተመለከቱ አይገልጹም።

English: They mention anything about the socioeconomic circumstances or difficulties that the women may face such as access or expensive healthy food etc.
Luganda: Tebalina kintu kyonna kye boogera ku mbeera ya byanfuna oba obuzibu abakazi bwe bayinza okusanga gamba ng’okufuna ebintu ebimu oba emmere ennungi ey’ebbeeyi n’ebirala.
Yoruba: Wọ́n mẹ́nuba ohunkóhun nípa ipò ọrọ̀-ajé àwùjọ tàbí ìṣòro tí àwọn obìnrin le è dojúkọ, bíi bí rírí tàbí wíwọ́n oúnjẹ́ tí ó ṣarelóore abbl.
Zulu: Babaulula izimo zenhlalo yabantu ezithinta umnotho okanye ubunzima kwezomnotho abesifazane abangabhekana nabo njengokungakwazi ukukuthenga ukudla okunempilo ngenxa yokubiza kwakho.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ambaci wani abu game da yanayin zamantakewa ko matsalolin da mata za su iya fuskanta kamar samun dama ko tsadar abinci mai kyau da makamantansu.
Northern Sotho: Ba boletše se sengwe le se sengwe ka ga maemo a ekonomi ya setšhaba goba gore basadi ba ka ba le mathata a go palelwa ke go fihlelela maemo ao goba dijo tša phepo tša go tura bjalobjalo.
Amharic: ስለ ማህበረ-ኢኮኖሚያዊ ሁኔታዎች ወይም ሴቶቹ ሊያጋጥሟቸው ስለሚችሉ ችግሮች ለምሳሌ እንደ ተደራሽነት እና ውድ ጤናማ ምግብ ወዘተ ያሉትን ማንኛውም ነገር ይጠቅሳሉ።

English: The researchers recommend that policy makers should scale up dietary health programmes to improve the diets of women of reproductive age, particularly university students.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza basemba nti abateeka amateeka balina okussaawo enteekateeka eziyamba okutumbula endya y’abakyala abali mu myaka egy’okuzaala, naddala abayizi ba ssettendekero.
Yoruba: Àwon olùwádìí dá àbá pé kí àwọn aṣòfin jára mọ́ àwọn ètò tí ó ní ṣe pẹ̀lú ìlera oúnjẹ́-yíyàn lati mú ìgbéga bá oúnjẹ́-yíyàn-jẹ àwọn obìnrin tí wọ́n ṣì wà ní ọdún ìbísi, pàápàá àwọn akẹ́kọ̀ọ́ Yunifásítì.
Zulu: Abacwaningi benze izincomo zokuba abasunguli benqubomgomo bandise izinhlelo eziphathelene nokubaluleka kokudla ngendlela enempilo, ukuze abesifazane abasenenzalo bakwazi ukudla ngendlela efanele, ikakhulukazi abafundi baseNyuvesi.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ba da shawarar cewa ‘yan majalisu su haɓaka shirye-shiryen kiwon lafiya na abinci don inganta abincin mata masu shekarun haihuwa, musamman ɗaliban jami'a.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba šišinya gore batho bao ba beago melao ba swanetše go tsenya tirišong mananeo a maphelo ka ga dijo ka nepo ya go kaonafatša dijo tša basadi bao ba lego mengwageng ya go belega bana, kudukudu baithuti ba yunibesithi.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ የመውለድ ዕድሜ ላይ ያሉ ሴቶች በተለይም የዩኒቨርሲቲ ተማሪዎችን አመጋገብ ለማሻሻል ፖሊሲ አውጪዎች የአመጋገብ ጤና ፕሮግራሞችን ማሳደግ እንዳለባቸው ይመክራሉ።

English: The study recommends that university eating premises should provide nutritious, varied, convenient meal options.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza kwasemba nti ebifo ebiriirwamu ku ssettendekero birina okubeeramu emmere erimu ebiriisa ey’enjawulo ate ng’eyanguyira abayizi.
Yoruba: Iṣẹ́ ìwadìí yìí dá àbá pé kí àwọn agbégbè oúnjẹ́ jíjẹ ní àwọn Yunifásíti rí i dájú pé wọ́n pèsè àwọn àṣàyàn oúnjẹ́ lóríṣìíríṣìí tí ó sì rọrùn.
Zulu: Ucwaningo lukhipha izincomo zokuthi izindawo zokudlela zasenyuvesi kumele zihlinzeke abafundi ngokudla okunomsoco okwehlukahlukene futhi okulula ukuthi abafundi bakuthenge.
Hausa: Binciken ya ba da shawarar cewa wuraren cin abinci na jami’a ya kamata su samar da zaɓin abinci mai gina jiki, iri-iri da kuma dacewa.
Northern Sotho: Dinyakišišo di šišinya gore mafelo a bojelo a ka yunibesithi a swanetše go fana ka dikgetho tša dijo tša phepo, tše di fapafapanego le tše kaone.
Amharic: ጥናቱ የዩኒቨርሲቲው የመመገቢያ ስፍራዎች ገንቢ፣ የተለያዩ እና ምቹ የሆኑ የምግብ  አማራጮችን እንዲያቀርቡ ይመክራል።

English: This would ensure that students are discouraged from relying on unhealthy fast foods.
Luganda: Kino kyandibyambyeko abayizi obuteesigulira ku mmere etaliimu biriisa.
Yoruba: Èyí yóò mú kí ó ṣe é ṣe fún àwọn akẹ́kọ̀ọ́ láti dẹ́kun ríra àwọn oúnjẹ tí kò dára fún ìlera wọn ní ilé oúnjẹ.
Zulu: Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abafundi banqundeke ukuthembela ekudleni okusheshayo nokungenayo impilo.
Hausa: Wannan zai tabbatar da cewa an hana ɗaliban dogaro da abinci marasa lafiya.
Northern Sotho: Se se tla netefatša gore baithuti ba hlohleletšwa gore ba se bote go ja dijo tša go apeelwa ruri tša go hloka phepo.
Amharic: ይህም ተማሪዎች ጤናማ ባልሆኑ ፈጣን ምግቦች ላይ ጥገኛ እንዳይሆኑ መበረታታቸውን ያረጋግጣል።
